title: Cauchy–Schwarz bound on total influence
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function, with influences $\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$ for $i = 1, \dots, n$ and total influence $I[f] = \sum_{i=1}^n \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$. Then
\[
  I[f]^2 \;\le\; n \sum_{i=1}^{n} \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]^2 .
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n (f : {0,1}^n → ℝ)
n is the arity / number of coordinates appearing as the multiplier on the right
replaced:
The total influence obeys
\[
  I[f]^2 \;\le\; n \sum_{i=1}^{n} \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]^2 .
